_doc: widget-routes.json: deprecated or removed pluggable widgets and the route to their replacement (one row per old widget).
Read by bin/repair/widgetroute.py (the recommendation per module and the automatic 1:1 replacement) and by
bin/repair/missing_deps.py (DEPRECATED-11: the rows whose blocks_from is 11). playbooks/widgets.md section 1 explains
the Charts lineage; replacements.tsv rows R10, R25 and R26 are the same widgets seen from triage.
match: full-match regex on the widget id. blocks_from: the Mendix major from which the old widget fails (null: deprecated,
still runs). fit: exact (every set property has the same key in the new widget: auto may be true), approximate (closest
Charts 6 option, a trade-off), manual (a person rebuilds it). props: old key -> new key. to_string: translatable
string properties the new widget declares as plain string (the en_US text, else the first, becomes the value).
reset: properties whose type changed; a set value is listed as approximated with the line given. plotly3: the static
JSON is checked against plotly3_dropped. needs_container: the new widget reads its object only inside a
data view, list or grid (Any Chart took a snippet parameter: a use straight on one is not replaced, the person wraps it).
minutes_per_use: the effort per widget (an exact swap: the look to check). alternatives: candidate B (and on) of the
route, shown next to the recommended one and proposed when the recommended one fails in the test build.
new: the widget id read from the installed package (Charts 6.2.0 Charts.mpk, Data Widgets, Tooltip); null where no
package was seen in a field app (never guessed).

plotly3_dropped.titlefont: plotly 3 dropped 'titlefont': the title takes the default font
plotly3_dropped.titleside: plotly 3 dropped 'titleside': the colour bar title sits at its default side
plotly3_dropped.titleposition: plotly 3 dropped 'titleposition': the title sits at its default place
plotly3_dropped.titleoffset: plotly 3 dropped 'titleoffset': the title sits at its default offset
plotly3_dropped.heatmapgl: plotly 3 dropped the 'heatmapgl' trace: change it to 'heatmap'
plotly3_dropped.pointcloud: plotly 3 dropped the 'pointcloud' trace: change it to 'scattergl'
plotly3_dropped.title-string: plotly 3 ignores a title written as plain text: the title is not shown until it is written as {"text": ...}
